description: This file defines a FooterView constructor function for a TodoMVC application, providing methods for rendering the footer with counts of remaining todos and handling UI interactions such as clearing completed todos.

methods.name: FooterView()
methods.description: Constructor function creating FooterView object with setup and render methods.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes event handlers for UI elements like the clear completed button.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Calls renderCounts with total and active todo counts.

methods.name: renderCounts
methods.description: Updates the footer display with the number of active todos, total todos, and toggles visibility of footer and clear button.
